## Q4 Fabrication vs review scores and acceptance (reviewed papers)

- GPT-5 (AIRev1): Spearman rho=-0.021 (p=0.789, n=173); mean score, papers with vs without fabricated refs: 2.30 vs 2.30
- Gemini 2.5 Pro (AIRev2): Spearman rho=-0.067 (p=0.378, n=173); mean score, papers with vs without fabricated refs: 4.16 vs 4.37
- Claude Sonnet 4 (AIRev3): Spearman rho=-0.026 (p=0.736, n=173); mean score, papers with vs without fabricated refs: 3.11 vs 3.07
- Human expert: Spearman rho=-0.289 (p=0.025, n=60); mean score, papers with vs without fabricated refs: 2.60 vs 3.34
- Acceptance rate: papers with >=1 fabricated ref 8.1% (3/37; 95% CI 2.8-21.3) vs without 25.7% (35/136; 95% CI 19.1-33.7)
- Fisher exact test (accepted x any fabricated): odds ratio=0.25, p=0.0243; table [[acc&fab, rej&fab],[acc&clean, rej&clean]]=[[3, 34], [35, 101]]
- Mean LLM score vs fabricated share: Spearman rho=-0.072 (p=0.347, n=173)
- Logistic regression accepted ~ share_fab + mean LLM score: coef(share_fab)=-43.85 (p=0.016), coef(mean_llm)=7.37 (p=1.06e-05), n=173

## Q5 Did reviewers notice? (reviewed papers with >=1 fabricated reference)

- Any LLM review explicitly states references are fabricated/non-existent/unverifiable: 13.5% (5/37; 95% CI 5.9-28.0)
- Any LLM review mentions references/citations at all: 75.7% (28/37; 95% CI 59.9-86.6)
- Human expert review explicitly states so (papers with a human review): 0.0% (0/10; 95% CI -0.0-27.8)
- False alarms: LLM 'strong' statements in papers without fabricated refs: 3.7% (5/136; 95% CI 1.6-8.3)
